Name: PinkStations Cloud Tilesheets
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[b][size=4]~PinkStations Cloud Tilesheets~
[/size][/b]Simple cloud tilesheets that are based on the clouds from Emily's dreamscape! There are 8 cloud color options currently!

For Farmers: This mod does nothing on its own, It is simply tilesheets made for modders to use in custom maps! 

For Modders: Feel free to use these in any maps you would like, I would love to see more clouds in the valley! Remember to add this as a requirement for your mod so it works! Please contact me if there's any tiles I haven't added that you would like to use! I'm very open to expanding the sheets for more versatility, I just added some basic tiles for now. Note, please do not modify or reupload my tilesheets without my permission (exception for personal use only)

Notes: 
~It should automatically find any recolor you're using but if it doesn't show up just select it manually. (I have not had any problems with it auto picking the recolor)
~If colors don't change/look mismatched after changing the season manually (through a mod) you'll have to sleep to the next day to fix it!
~If you're using options like bluer grass for Starblue / lighter dirt for Wittily, you'll have to manually change the recolor selection to the recolor you're using to get it to show up.
~There is no recolor selection option for Yellog recolor as it has many options so if you're using that you just need to change the season colors in the config. If you're not using it then leave the options false.

How to Install:
~ Make sure you have a mod that is using these tilesheets (they don't do anything alone)
~ Download and then unzip
~ Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
~ The tilesheets will now apply to the map!

Recolor Compatibility:

~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolor [/url]

~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor
[/url]~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367] Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14765]Project Yellog Modular Town Overhaul[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799]Project Yellog Modular Recolor Options[/url]
[b][i][font=Comic Sans MS][size=1]Thank you to all the lovely recolor creators who allowed me to make these tilesheets compatible! <3﻿[/size][/font][/i][/b]

Please let me know about anything you would like to see added to these or any issues! ~enjoy
